overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Adopt → project → upgrade. This page only lists what needs deciding now.

queue.title: Decision queue
queue.clear: All clear — nothing here needs you right now.
queue.unmanaged: {n} skills on disk are not managed yet
queue.conflict: {n} skills changed both locally and upstream — file-by-file merge needed

targets.title: Target state
targets.absentHint: This client was not found on this machine; the next scan restores it automatically — the target record was not deleted

library.title: My skills
library.none: No managed skills yet. Adopt some from Discover.
library.lead: One entity, many places: every client sees a link to it.
library.selectHint: Tick rows to project in bulk
library.legendNote: A dot = what this link is doing there right now, a dash = no link here
library.removeNoLinks: Not projected anywhere yet, so there is nothing to retract.
library.removeTrashedNote: The whole directory is moved, never deleted; restore it from there if you need it back.
library.removeExternalNote: This is your own directory — Heron only points at it, the files stay exactly where they are.
library.removeCaveat: The name is free to reinstall once this is gone.

discover.title: Discover
discover.subtitle: These skills exist on disk but Heron does not manage them yet.
discover.nestedWarning: Nested suspects are reported only, never edited automatically (design D8).
discover.previewHint: Preview first: this step only reads. Files move after you confirm, and only after a backup.
discover.adoptedNothing: None of the {n} selected paths were adopted (they may have moved or changed). Scan again and retry.
discover.placementHint: Each entry is handled by the placement you chose
discover.liveBindNote: This entry is a link to {target}: it keeps pointing there, nothing is copied or re-pointed
discover.leaveBehindNote: This entry is a link to {target}; copying it into the store leaves that directory unreferenced
discover.noSlug: Not recognised as a skill; will be skipped
discover.backupNote: A backup is taken before anything moves; a failure leaves the originals untouched.

sources.title: Sources & markets
sources.lead: One search box hits every enabled source at once; results group by source and install row by row.
sources.subtitle: One query asks every enabled source; installable rows install directly, browse-only ones open with your keywords
sources.searchAllPlaceholder: Search all sources for a skill, e.g. pdf, code review…
sources.idleHint: Type a keyword and search — results are grouped by source and appear here. The sources below can be opened in your browser.
sources.barTail: {n} searchable sources online · results ranked by relevance
sources.failDesc: This source is unreachable or returned nothing.
sources.browserHint: {n} · no public search API, excluded from unified search
sources.needGitAddress: Only installable repo URLs can be one-click installed
sources.pasteTitle: Paste a git URL to install
sources.pasteHint: github / gitee · repo or /tree/ subpath · Enter to install
sources.pasteBad: Not an http(s) URL; GitHub / Gitee repos or subpaths supported.
sources.pasteDirect: Install directly: backend resolves the repo and default branch ({host}).
sources.planWholeRepo: whole repository (the skill needs its sibling directories)
sources.planNote: → clones into the local library, then projects into your enabled clients.
sources.planExisting: That slug already exists — install would conflict, upgrade instead
sources.searchEmpty: No source matched «{q}» — try a shorter keyword or English.
sources.allDisabled: Every source is disabled. Enable at least one above.
sources.pasteUrl: Paste a git URL and press Enter
sources.favHint: Keep the good open-source skills you find (GitHub / Gitee / ModelScope) and install them with one click
sources.favEmpty: No favourites yet. Tap “Add to favourites” on a result, or add one here.
sources.favFormHint: Save a good open-source skill you found anywhere, then install it with one click.
sources.drawerSub: Note down an open-source skill on github / gitee and install it from “My favourites” in one click — no need to search again. Paste a URL and it parses owner / repo / subpath. Esc to close.
sources.fieldNameHint: The name shown in the favourites list and install plan; left blank it is auto-filled from the parsed result.
sources.fieldUrlHint: Supports github.com and gitee.com, optionally with /tree/<branch>/<subpath>.
sources.fieldDescPh: What this skill does, and why you kept it.
sources.vIdle: Not parsed yet · type a URL to see host / owner / repo / subpath and the landing path.
sources.vLinkReasonVal: Not a github.com / gitee.com repo, so it cannot be cloned and installed
sources.vLinkAfterVal: in favourites it can only be “opened”; “one-click install” is unavailable
sources.vInstalled: already in the store; re-installing is skipped
sources.vNewAction: create a copy + project links to your enabled clients
sources.urlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
sources.parsedLink: Not an installable repo URL ({host}) — it saves, but can only “Open in browser”.
sources.localOnly: Favourites stay in this local list; nothing is uploaded.
sources.briefQoder: Qoder has a public catalog but no public search API: open its search page with keywords, then copy the repo URL from the detail page.
sources.briefSkillhub: skillhub.cn exposes no public REST search: open its search page with keywords, then save the repo URL to favourites.
sources.briefModelscope: ModelScope skills are repos: modelscope.cn/{owner}/{repo} — paste the URL to clone into the local library and project it.
sources.briefSkillsmp: skillsmp is a leaderboard aggregator pointing at hosted repos: browse in the browser, then paste the repo URL to install.
sources.briefFallback: {name}: browse in the browser, then save the repo URL to favourites.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: A target is the directory a client actually reads; project targets only apply to that project.

upgrades.title: Updates
upgrades.lead: Three-way merge: local and upstream changes are both kept; whatever cannot merge waits for your decision, file by file.
upgrades.overwriteBody: “Keep local edits on update” is off: the upgrade replaces the selected skills' local changes with the upstream version. This cannot be undone (only rollback history is kept). Continue?

doctor.title: Health
doctor.lead: Read-only checks: duplicates, broken links, nested suspects, lost sources. Nothing on disk is changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.nativeScanOff: Disabled by default — no configuration is written to clients we haven't verified.
settings.updateFailed: Update check failed (expected in local dev builds)
settings.lead: Theme, language, app updates and client capabilities — changes apply immediately.
settings.colorModeHint: Follow the system, or pin light / dark.

paletteDesc.dusk: Warm paper base + tan accent, deep olive at night
paletteDesc.forest-ink: Cool green paper + ink-green accent, forest night in dark
paletteDesc.wanqing: Warm paper + indigo accent, night blue in dark

settings.proxyAuto: Leave empty to auto-detect (env / git / system proxy)
settings.proxyHint: Installs and marketplace searches go through this address, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897 or socks5://127.0.0.1:7897. Clear it to fall back to auto-detection.
settings.autoDoctorHint: Run the read-only check-up after every scan
settings.keepLocalHint: Three-way merge on upgrade, preserving your changes
settings.themeNote: The theme applies immediately and is remembered for next launch.

errors.E_GIT_MISSING: git was not found; please install it
errors.E_NETWORK: Network request failed; check your proxy and retry
errors.E_CLONE_TIMEOUT: The download timed out; check your network or set a proxy in Settings
errors.E_SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS: That address is ambiguous and needs your choice
errors.E_SLUG_CONFLICT: A skill with that name already exists
errors.E_REF_NOT_FOUND: Branch, tag or path not found
errors.E_DRIFTED: The destination was changed by something else; stopped
errors.E_NOT_MANAGED: That location is not managed by Heron
errors.E_MARKET_UNAVAILABLE: The market is unreachable right now

conflict.title: Resolve conflicts
conflict.hint: {n} files: decide each one; “Save and retry” commits your choices and re-runs the upgrade.

scan.incompleteHint: The directory ceiling was reached, so this result is incomplete
scan.toastTruncated: Partial result · {limit} directories is the ceiling

shell.pendingHint: {n} waiting: unadopted skills, upgradable skills and broken projections. Open the check-up.
shell.gitHint: Git fetches and diffs skill sources (this is not the app's version). Open Sources.
shell.gitMissingHint: Git not found: cloning and upgrading sources need it. Open Settings.
